requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for this fixture and does not invent one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your current mailing address, written by hand, so the court and the prosecuting attorney can reach you

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Petitioner telephone number and email address
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no contact details for this fixture and does not invent them
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the telephone number and email address you want the court to use

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Last four digits of the Social Security number
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed packet instruction is that only the last four digits appear on the petition and that the full number is never persisted, so the platform holds no value to write
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the last four digits of your Social Security number, and only the last four - the full number goes on the Confidential Information Form

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every Indiana conviction in any county, and whether each is eligible yet
requiredBeforeFiling.why: one petition per lifetime under I.C. 35-38-9-9(i) makes this list decisive, and only the certified limited criminal history the participant orders establishes it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the full list from your certified limited criminal history, county by county, with the eligibility date of each

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether the offense involved serious bodily injury
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed record classifies this as a legal judgment rather than a fact the platform holds, and lists it as a manual completion item
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the answer, taken from your own court record and from legal advice if it is not obvious

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Additional information the petitioner wants the court to know
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed record says this is participant-authored and that LegalEase formats the participant's own facts rather than composing an argument
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: anything else you want the court to know, in your own words

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: Clerk of the court of conviction

Check your answer to "Have you paid all fines, fees and court costs, and satisfied any restitution?" against Confirmation that all fines, fees, costs and restitution are satisfied, and correct the packet if they disagree.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: Prosecuting attorney of the county of conviction
